query: SELECT r.sample_id,r.series_id,r.segment,r.elapsed_ns,r.wall_ns,r.period_ms,r.value_c,r.freshness,r.source_wall_ns FROM raw_samples r JOIN series s USING(series_id) WHERE s.kind='cpuMain' ORDER BY elapsed_ns
formula: merge original collector + complete terminal SQL rows by sample_id; assert all overlaps exactly equal; restrict to period_ms=1000 and phase wall_ns window; sort elapsed_ns
limits: Same process/session continuous extension; original failed XCTest is not changed. Successful finish intervals are not exact scheduler skipped or read/display latency.
